card.name: Dalton's atomic weights text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, the, relative, be) in an old chemistry text about atoms, elements and their relative weights. It is strongest just before words like weight or number.

modes.label: Linking words in atom descriptions
modes.description: Short words like by, the, in inside sentences about how simple atoms are denoted or combined.
modes.example: are denoted<< by>> a small circle, with some distinctive mark

modes.label: Before weight terms
modes.description: The word relative or the right before a mention of weights or numbers of particles.
modes.example: it has justly been considered an important object to ascertain the<< relative>> weights of the simples which constitute a compound
